subject.title: fix(azure): responses model aliases route correctly

question: Is mock Azure Responses probe proof sufficient to merge this auth-provider owner-selection fix, or should the PR wait for a live Azure account credential exchange?
rationale: The code path is a resolver/auth-owner boundary and the supplied proof shows OpenClaw routing behavior against a local mock server, but live Azure credentials were not exercised.

options.title: Accept resolver-layer proof
options.body: Land the PR once required checks are green because the bug is owner selection before network credentials and the mock probe demonstrates the selected provider, API, base URL, and request path.

options.title: Require live Azure proof
options.body: Pause the PR until a maintainer or contributor runs a real Azure Responses account probe showing the same provider owner and credential route.

recommendation.title: Accept resolver-layer proof
recommendation.body: Land the PR once required checks are green because the bug is owner selection before network credentials and the mock probe demonstrates the selected provider, API, base URL, and request path.
